# PageCurl motion provenance

Reader's normalized-coordinate cylindrical bend is informed by the public
algorithm documented in Harri Smatt's `harism/android-pagecurl` project.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/harism/android-pagecurl>
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Upstream copyright: Copyright 2012 Harri Smatt
- Referenced files: `CurlView.java`, `CurlMesh.java`

The current material-contact solver, straight-axis cylindrical bend, immutable
indexed mesh, velocity-continuous settlement, GLES 3 shaders, page texture lifecycle,
Host barriers, and HarmonyOS bridge are Reader-owned implementations. No demo
imagery, icons, Android framework code, or Legado GPL page-turn source is
copied into the Reader application.
